messages:
mina_customer: Hey team — our embedding requests suddenly started returning 1536-dim vectors; we expect 768. Nothing in our code changed on our side. Seen in production, started ~30m ago. :frowning:
mina_customer: Example response snippet: `{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","embedding":[...1536 numbers...]}` — we called the small model `text-embedding-3-small` before.
alex_support: sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl you used (headers + body) and a request_id if available? also which org/project should be billed? :mag_right:
mina_customer: curl we use: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer proj_sk_live_ABC123" \
 -H "X-Redwood-Org: org-staging-999" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":"search term"}'```
mina_customer: Request id from response header: `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`
mina_customer: Billing should go to org `org-prod-555` (we run production under prod org). The `org-staging-999` header is a leftover from an old proxy — i thought proj key would override.
jordan_prodeng: thanks — adding context: the runtime picks the model variant based on project key mapping unless an explicit org header is present; org header routes to that org's default model catalog. That means if the request includes `X-Redwood-Org` we route using that org's catalog. :thinking:
ajex_support: (typo -> alex_support): got it. So your request had mismatched org header (staging) while using prod project key, so routing landed on `text-embedding-3-large` which is staging's default. That explains the 1536 dim.
mina_customer: ugh. but why did the service accept both? shouldn't we get a validation error when project/org mismatch occurs?
jordan_prodeng: good call. Currently precedence is: if `X-Redwood-Org` present, use org routing; otherwise fall back to project mapping. We do not block mixed combos today — just trust headers. We should warn.
alex_support: I'm going to repro quickly with your request_id. jordan, can you pull the router logs for `req_0a1b2c3d`?
jordan_prodeng: pulled logs: `2026-03-15T15:10:02Z req_0a1b2c3d route=org-staging-999 model=text-embedding-3-large handler=embed-runtime-07` — confirms routing to staging model.
mina_customer: And billing charged `org-staging-999` ? I see extra charges on the staging account now.
olivia_billing: confirming — I can see a few token charges attributed to org-staging-999 at 15:10 UTC. We'll reverse the charges if this was accidental. Please confirm which org should be charged and we'll create an adjustment. :white_check_mark:
mina_customer: Please charge org-prod-555. We want reversals on the staging account.
mina_customer: For mitigation — is there a quick way to force requests to use project mapping and ignore X-Redwood-Org?
jordan_prodeng: short term: remove the `X-Redwood-Org` header from requests. If you cannot, set `model` explicitly to a model that exists in the target project (e.g., `text-embedding-3-small`) but note that if the org's catalog doesn't have that model name, it'll still pick their closest mapping.
alex_support: I'll patch our support docs to call this out and add a proactive check in our SDKs. For you immediate fix, Mina, could you toggle the proxy to drop the `X-Redwood-Org` header?
mina_customer: yes we can patch proxy, pushing a quick rule now.
mina_customer: pushed — retesting...
mina_customer: retest response: `{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","embedding":[...768 numbers...]}` — looks good, dims are back. :tada:
jordan_prodeng: great. I'll file a platform ticket to add a validation: return 400 if `Authorization` project and `X-Redwood-Org` are mismatched OR at least add a strong warning in the response headers. Also adding a router audit log flag and an alert when routing deviates from project defaults.
alex_support: followups: 1) billing adjustment (olivia) 2) docs/SDK warning + patch (alex) 3) platform validation ticket (jordan) 4) add a dedicated note in our incident KB about org header precedence.
olivia_billing: created billing ticket BILL-2026-034 to reverse staging charges and apply to `org-prod-555`. I'll DM you for confirmation.
jordan_prodeng: created platform ticket PLAT-4532: "Reject mixed auth/org header combos or warn by default". Assigning to runtime team, severity P2.
mina_customer: huge thanks all. can we also get a short note about detection so we can alert our engineers if this happens again? maybe add a warning header like `X-Redwood-Warning: org-header-used`?
jordan_prodeng: noted — adding that suggestion to PLAT-4532.
alex_support: closing loop: I'll follow up in this thread when docs + SDK changes are live and when billing is confirmed reversed. For now: remove `X-Redwood-Org` to keep behavior consistent. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: docs-update/4012 -> staging (by alex_support)
mina_customer: thanks, I'll watch for the billing note and docs. appreciate the quick help!
